name: relic
description: Persistent grounding, continuity, provenance, truth-domain separation, and authority boundaries for AI reasoning.

interface.shortDescription: R.e.L.i.C. grounds AI in persistent identity, provenance, canon, and continuity.
interface.longDescription: R.e.L.i.C. gives AI a compact external continuity layer for persistent identity, provenance, truth domains, source-linked Shaelvien/RIST project knowledge, remembered relationships, and authority boundaries. Its context translator composes database records and authenticated neurons into bounded Rune/Glyph/Shaep pointers so ChatGPT can expand exact detail only when needed, reducing repeated context reconstruction without replacing source data or granting authority over canon or world truth.
defaultPrompt: Use R.e.L.i.C. to ground this conversation in the relevant canon and persistent context.
Source the documented R.e.L.i.C./Shaelvien project record for this topic and keep dates, status, truth domain, and provenance visible.
Recall what R.e.L.i.C. already knows about this subject before we reconstruct it from chat.
Validate these claims against R.e.L.i.C. truth-domain, provenance, identity, and authority rules.
Translate the relevant database and ReLiC neuron context into a compact Rune/Glyph/Shaep pack for this task, expanding exact records only when needed.
